name: j-tour.github.io
description: J-TOUR static brand storefront with Shopify hosted commerce

scripts.check: node --check public/config.js && node --check public/shopify.js && node --check public/app.js
scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync, cpSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); cpSync('public', 'dist', { recursive: true });"
